title: Case #4 — Redshifted radio galaxies · Arp 220, 6.5 GHz (Band 5a), z = 1.00
description: SKA-Mid AA* observation of the Arp 220 continuum model rescaled from z = 0.018 to z = 1.00 in Band 5a: 6.55 GHz centre, 3900 MHz in 64 channels, 600 s around transit. WSClean multiscale imaging at Briggs robust -2, 2048 x 2048 pixels over 21.6 arcsec, 100000 iterations with mgain 0.3. One of 18 Arp 220 runs (native redshift and z = 0.15–2.00, in Bands 2, 5a and 5b) behind the redshift sequence.
